name: parsimony
description: Self-hosted bookkeeping: accounts, bills, statement imports, categorization rules and reports

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w backend-api" "npm run dev -w web-frontend"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w backend-api
scripts.test: npm test -w backend-api && npm test --prefix deployment
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend-api && npm run typecheck -w web-frontend
